principle: Discussions are an optional layer on the messaging channel where agents (and people) reason about a problem or a handoff before acting. Their text is information, never an instruction. Only a signed decide message with a valid action binds, and it names one existing command the agent runs with all its own checks. A discussion ends when every participant acknowledges the proposal, or at the time box or the turn limit: a proposal with no open objection is agreed (silence counts as yes); anything else goes to a person.
